params.prompt: The SAME WOMAN as the reference image — identical face shape, identical eyes, nose and mouth, unmistakably the same person — but FIVE YEARS YOUNGER STILL: she is now exactly TWENTY years old, a village girl barely out of her teens. Make her face rounder and softer with full youthful cheeks and a little baby fat along the jaw; skin completely smooth, taut, dewy and luminous with no lines at all anywhere, not even faint ones; eyes bright and clear with no shadow beneath them; lips fuller and softer; expression young, shy, slightly unsure rather than composed. Jet-black hair centre-parted in one long thick braid. Keep the red-and-pink bandhani odhni over her head, the small gold nathni on her LEFT nostril, the red bindi, glass bangles. Fair wheat-golden Malwa complexion. She must read as TWENTY — a girl, not a woman of twenty-five or thirty. Sharp photorealistic portrait, natural window light, plain background, front-facing. No text anywhere.
